name: As Water Cascades
summary: As Water Cascades is an Alliance quest in Darkshore where players test the nature of the mysterious red crystal jutting from the eastern mountain wall. By pouring sacred moonwell water from Auberdine over its surface, players attempt to pierce its opaque exterior and uncover where it came from.

sections.title: Purifying the Unknown
sections.body: After the red crystal is first sighted high on the eastern cliffs of Darkshore, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea devises a way to examine its composition safely. Moonwell waters carry potent divine and restorative magic, blessed by the night elves' devotion to Elune. Glynda reasons that dousing the alien monolith with water drawn from the moonwell in Auberdine will trigger a reaction, cutting through its strange, opaque shell without destroying it outright.

sections.title: The Shadow of Felwood
sections.body: Nal'Shea's concern stems largely from geography. Darkshore's eastern ridge looms beneath the corrupted heights of Felwood, a forest twisted by demonic energies during the Third War. If the red spire is linked to Felwood's corruption, handling it carries immense risk. When the sacred water trickles down the crystal's lattice, the humming stone momentarily turns transparent, hinting that whatever lies trapped within requires a closer look.

faq.q: Where do I get the water for this quest?
faq.answer: You must draw the water from the moonwell located in the night elf settlement of Auberdine, using the empty vial provided by Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea.

faq.q: Why does moonwell water affect the crystal?
faq.answer: Moonwells hold consecrated, magic-rich water blessed by Elune. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea anticipates that its purifying essence will react against the foreign energy of the stone and reveal its hidden composition.

faq.q: Where is the red crystal located?
faq.answer: The mysterious red crystal rests along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall, nestled into the rocky foothills separating the shore from the highlands above.

faq.q: Why is Sentinel Glynda worried about Felwood?
faq.answer: Felwood lies directly east and above Darkshore, ravaged by demonic corruption from the Third War. Because the crystal appeared near the boundary ridge, Glynda fears it may share that foul, demonic origin.

faq.q: What happens when you pour the water on the crystal?
faq.answer: Glynda expects the potent moonwell water to reveal a clue about the crystal's composition. Its reaction is discovered when you pour the water over it.

faq.q: Who gives the quest As Water Cascades?
faq.answer: The quest is given by Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine, immediately following the reconnaissance mission, The Red Crystal.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, moonwells are sacred fonts of life and solace. Using their consecrated waters as a tool of revelation highlights how central Elune's grace is to untangling threats along their borders.
Druids watching over Darkshore's fragile ecosystem are naturally suspicious of unnatural foreign formations, especially along the ridge below corrupted Felwood.
Alliance scouts based in Auberdine must keep the coast secure from looming corruption creeping down from the eastern highlands.
